notes: Token figures are API usage fields recorded in sub-agent transcripts; input tokens include a fixed agent harness overhead (first_call_input_tokens) identical across conditions.
Logged output_tokens are mid-stream snapshots and only a lower bound; generated_chars is the exact size of text and tool-call inputs the agent produced.
p-values are exact two-sided sign tests over 10 tasks; no correction for multiple comparisons.
